newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX seat sells for record $625,000.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX seat sells for record $625,000.

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange said one of its seats sold for a record $625,000 Monday, barely two weeks after the previous record was set at $600,000 on Jan 14.
NYMEX said the seat is currently the second most valuable on any futures exchange in the country after a seat on the Chicago Board of Trade was recently sold for $700,000.
